entries.title: II Corinthians 12:1
segments: ¶It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord:

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:2
segments: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago--whether in the body I do not know, or whether out of the body I do not know, God knows--such a one was caught up to the third heaven.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:3
segments: And I know such a man--whether in the body or out of the body I do not know, God knows--

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:4
segments: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard inexpressible words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:5
segments: Of such a one I will boast; yet of myself I will not boast, except in my infirmities.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:6
segments: For though I might desire to boast, I will not be a fool; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, lest anyone should think of me above what he sees me [to be] or hears from me.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:7
segments: And lest I should be exalted above measure by the abundance of the revelations, a thorn in the flesh was given to me, a messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I be exalted above measure.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:8
segments: Concerning this thing I pleaded with the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:9
segments: And He said to me, "My grace is sufficient for you, for My strength is made perfect in weakness." Therefore most gladly I will rather boast in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:10
segments: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in needs, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ's sake. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:11
segments: ¶I have become a fool in boasting; you have compelled me. For I ought to have been commended by you; for in nothing was I behind the most eminent apostles, though I am nothing.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:12
segments: Truly the signs of an apostle were accomplished among you with all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty deeds.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:13
segments: For what is it in which you were inferior to other churches, except that I myself was not burdensome to you? Forgive me this wrong!

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:14
segments: Now [for] the third time I am ready to come to you. And I will not be burdensome to you; for I do not seek yours, but you. For the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:15
segments: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for your souls; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I am loved.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:16
segments: But be that [as it may], I did not burden you. Nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you by cunning!

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:17
segments: Did I take advantage of you by any of those whom I sent to you?

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:18
segments: I urged Titus, and sent our brother with [him]. Did Titus take advantage of you? Did we not walk in the same spirit? Did [we] not [walk] in the same steps?

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:19
segments: Again, do you think that we excuse ourselves to you? We speak before God in Christ. But [we do] all things, beloved, for your edification.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:20
segments: For I fear lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I wish, and [that] I shall be found by you such as you do not wish; lest [there be] contentions, jealousies, outbursts of wrath, selfish ambitions, backbitings, whisperings, conceits, tumults;

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:21
segments: lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and I shall mourn for many who have sinned before and have not repented of the uncleanness, fornication, and lewdness which they have practiced.
